source.title: Observation of Second Sound in Graphite over 200 K
source.authors: Zhiwei Ding, Ke Chen, Bai Song, Jungwoo Shin, Alexei A. Maznev, Keith A. Nelson, Gang Chen
source_locator: Supplementary Information p.3, section 2, Eqs. S1-S5: PBTE and temperature-response derivation
Supplementary Information p.3, Eq. S2: deviational phonon energy density g_mu
Supplementary Information p.3, Eq. S4: Delta T_tilde = sum_mu(g_mu_tilde) / C
Supplementary Information p.5, section 3, Eqs. S7-S10: ballistic TTG temperature-difference observable
source.preprocessing: byte-preserving archival download from the official PMC Open Access S3 object; formula transcription from the full PDF; no digitization, interpolation, fitting, smoothing, numeric heat-capacity extraction, or target-curve access
source.source_data_role: DERIVED_STANDARD_PHYSICS_MAPPING; no numeric calibration values consumed

formula_records.locator: Supplementary Information p.3, Eq. S2 definition immediately below the equation
formula_records.canonical_notation: g_mu := deviational phonon energy density of mode mu

formula_records.locator: Supplementary Information p.3, paragraph after Eq. S2
formula_records.canonical_notation: p_mu := modal thermal excitation fraction; C_src := source-defined total modal heat capacity per volume
formula_records.units: p_mu dimensionless; c_mu and C_src in J m^-3 K^-1

formula_records.locator: Supplementary Information p.5, Eq. S10 and preceding sentence
formula_records.source_notation: Delta_T_TTG = T(x=0,t) - T(x=l/2,t); measured TTG signal is proportional to this temperature difference
formula_records.canonical_notation: Delta_Tq(t) := source TTG peak-to-null temperature-response difference

ontology_contract.C_src: source-defined total modal heat capacity per volume in the Ding PBTE derivation
ontology_contract.uet_C: collective system-behaviour coordinate; not heat capacity
ontology_contract.g_mu: source-derived deviational phonon energy density; not UET Phi
ontology_contract.Phi: base UET effective response variable; no identity with temperature or g_mu is asserted
ontology_contract.R_gen: derived history trace; no new state or backreaction is introduced by this mapping
ontology_contract.R_obs: observer record remains separate from physical PBTE dynamics

regime_contract.source_material: graphite in the Ding 2022 experimental and first-principles PBTE lane
regime_contract.response_regime: linearized PBTE about T0 with thermally distributed initial heating
regime_contract.heat_capacity_interpretation: C_src is volumetric modal heat capacity in the source response equation; this package does not promote it to an independently measured equilibrium c_v row
regime_contract.gatech_correspondence: PROHIBITED_WITHOUT_EXPLICIT_MATERIAL_MAPPING; Georgia Tech EMS-5000 c_p and assumed density are not consumed

required_next_inputs: Ding-compatible mode-resolved c_mu(T) or a reproducible first-principles input/output package
source-locked unit-cell volume and temperature/regime identity
uncertainty or numerical-convergence contract for C_src(T)
independently derived UET energy-density scale e0
base Phi to Delta_u_ph derivation or independent calibration

claim_boundary: This package source-locks the Ding PBTE formula mapping from mode-summed deviational phonon energy density to the source temperature response and TTG peak-to-null observable. It does not provide numeric C_src(T), identify C_src with UET C, identify g_mu or Phi_E with base Phi, derive e0, calibrate alpha_Phi_K, consume Xie 2026, or close Topic 13.
